title: Decision: a reply or reaction names its target's first version (agent choice, epic mimid-qqtk)
description: mimi-content-10 §5.2, §5.3, §5.5 note: a reply or reaction refers to a specific message ID, i.e. a version. Readings: (a) the version the user saw (the latest edit), (b) the first version. The store keeps only the first version's whole 32-octet ID; later versions keep their 10 reference octets (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Message Identifiers resolves by those octets, and records aliases). Chosen: (b), the first version, which every receiver that stored the message resolves. INVENTED choice. Code: mimid-agent-store action.rs Store::reply_to. Doc: agent-frontends.md §7.26, §7.27.
